title: VCF filter regression input subset with SARS-CoV-2 sample columns

provenance.description: Repository test VCF metadata states reference=refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta:NC_045512v2 and source=faToVcf refPlus.unmapped.aligned.fasta stdout. The file contains sample labels with place/date/accession-like strings and variant/genotype rows. No generating FASTA, original callset, paper, accession mapping, or redistribution permission was inspected.

biological_context.experimental_units: VCF columns label SARS-CoV-2 samples; inspected header includes 12 sample columns.
biological_context.assay: Sequence variant calls in VCF; exact assay/library and calling pipeline beyond faToVcf source metadata are unknown.
biological_context.design: Unknown source cohort/design; fixture is used to regression-test filtering and renaming, not documented as a representative study sample.
metadata: sample labels include location, sample identifiers, dates, and some accession-like strings
monoploid genotype encoding is consumed by vcfFilter

assets.processing_stage: fixture input; header says faToVcf output against NC_045512v2 reference
assets.relationship: Primary filter test fixture; no relationship to a full source dataset established.

assets.processing_stage: small exclusion-position fixture consumed by vcfFilter tests
assets.relationship: Separate test input for exact CHROM/POS exclusion; not asserted to be an independent biological dataset.

access_and_terms.access: Public source repository file at pinned revision.
access_and_terms.redistribution: Unknown; repository-level license differs by directory and redistribution eligibility for fixture observations was not established.

inspection: Inspected the VCF header and bounded contents from the pinned GitHub raw file, and the test makefile rules showing this fixture used for min-AC, ID-renaming, genotype/no-genotype, and exclude tests. No data tool was executed.
limitations: Biological observations are evident from sample identifiers and genotypes, but originating accession(s), publication, exact sample count represented across the file, and source callset are not documented in inspected evidence.
No study ID is assigned because the fixture does not identify one.
Reference FASTA and generation procedure are not bundled with this inspected fixture; no checksums, file-level license, or reuse terms were confirmed.
Do not equate this regression fixture with a ready, approved task dataset without resolving its original provenance and terms.
